Advertises eighteen tools — validate_suite, list_step_types, describe_step_type, search_docs, plan_coverage, scaffold_suite, run_suite, explain_run, diagnose_run, explain_diagnostic, get_schema, normalize_suite, get_run_events, get_run_status, cancel_run, list_runs, get_step_timeline, get_run_artifacts — plus a vendored-documentation MCP resource pair and a per-code diagnostic catalogue resource, so an agent can validate, normalize, and scaffold .e2e.yaml suites, browse the step-type catalogue and the language's own JSON Schema, plan a suite set's coverage and gap findings, run suites with a taxonomy-faithful verdict, poll, list and gracefully cancel those runs, diagnose a run's JSON Lines event stream, page that stream's raw events, inventory what a run left behind, obtain Fail-only Healer patch proposals, and look up any VFX-* code's meaning and fix without shelling out to vouchfx and parsing its output by hand. The server is strictly read-only: it never writes, modifies, or deletes a suite file.
